title: Design: Change category window shows the current category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new work order for the regular customer, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost, converted to No Charge with the category Goodwill, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-07-3c-change-category.png, iwo-happy-25-25-change-category.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the no-charge work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu in the header.
  3. Click Change category.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A window "Change category for work order [number]" opens with the Category select showing Goodwill.
  • Buttons Cancel and Save; Save is greyed out until something changes.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R6: “Change category opens the dialog "Change category for work order [number]" with the Category select (the current category preselected) and, when the new category requires it, the Original work order and Original line selects of S2-R2 (changing to a category that does not require them clears them) and the buttons Cancel and Save; Save is enabled once the category, the original work order or the original line differs from the current values (as on a line, S12-R5), so a missing original can be added before Close; it changes nothing else.”
